exposure: expectant management (up to 48 hours vs up to 24 hours)
outcome: Successful trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) rate
cohort: 158 primiparous women with singleton pregnancy and a prior low-transverse cesarean delivery who presented with term PROM and requested TOLAC
finding: Expectant management up to 48 hours in women with TOLAC presenting with term PROM was associated with a lower rate of induction of labor and similar maternal and neonatal outcomes compared to expectant management up to 24 hours.
mod_finding: Expectant management up to 48 hours in women with TOLAC presenting with term PROM was associated with a lower rate of induction of labor and similar maternal and neonatal outcomes compared to expectant management up to 24 hours.
